Onboarding.title: Onboarding case
Onboarding.description: A deterministic onboarding case (one per hire): the concrete legal gates for a new employee's first week — contract signed, WID identity check, BSN/IBAN validated, IT provisioned, pensioen aangemeld — as checklist boolean/date fields, governed by a simplified six-state declarative lifecycle (onboarding-wizard-mvp). MVP-scoped from the 2026-05 spec/onboarding-wizard draft's 13-state machine and 15-step wizard stepper: no OnboardingStep/WIDCheck/BSNValidatie/Reminder side entities, no wizard stepper UI (follow-up nc-vue widget, design.md D6), no BSN elfproef/IBAN modulus-97 validation services, no IT auto-provisioning, no reminder/escalation engine. The checklist gates named on each lifecycle transition are enforced by audit rules (lib/Standards/Checks/NlOnboardingChecks.php), NOT by write-time guard classes — guard wiring for compliance-checked schemas is owned by the active hrmq-rule-compliance-enforcement change (design.md D2).

contract_bevestigen.description: The employment contract has been signed. Checklist gate: contractSigned = true (enforced by audit rule, not a write-time guard — see hrmq-rule-compliance-enforcement).

gegevens_valideren.description: The hire's BSN and IBAN have been checked. Checklist gate: bsnValidated = true AND ibanVerified = true (audit-enforced).

gereed_melden.description: The case is ready for the first workday. Checklist gate: widCheckDone = true (WID check on or before startDate, Wet op de identificatieplicht art. 15 jo. Wet LB 1964 art. 28 lid 1 onder f), itProvisioned = true, pensioenAangemeld = true (audit-enforced).

starten.description: startDate has been reached; the proeftijd clock now runs against proeftijdEndDate (BW 7:652).

afronden.description: The proeftijd completed without termination; the onboarding case is closed out.

annuleren.description: The hire is cancelled (no-show, or proeftijd termination) before the case reaches afgerond.

employeeId.title: Employee
employeeId.description: UUID reference to the Employee this onboarding case hires.

startDate.title: Start date
startDate.description: First workday. Anchor date for the WID identity check timing (nl-onboarding-wid-check) and the proeftijd clock.

proeftijdEndDate.title: Proeftijd end date
proeftijdEndDate.description: End of the probationary period, if agreed. BW 7:652-capped (max 1 month for fixed-term contracts under 2 years, max 2 months for permanent/2+ year contracts) but a contractual input, not derived — checked by nl-onboarding-proeftijd-bewaking. Null when no proeftijd was agreed.

status.title: Status
status.description: Case lifecycle status. Governed by the x-openregister-lifecycle state machine (aangenomen -> contract_getekend -> gegevens_gevalideerd -> gereed_eerste_werkdag -> proeftijd_lopend -> afgerond, cancellable pre-afgerond).

contractSigned.title: Contract signed
contractSigned.description: Whether the signed employment contract is on file (artefact stored in the files widget). Gates the contract_bevestigen transition.

widCheckDone.title: WID check done
widCheckDone.description: Whether the WID identity check was performed (original document seen, copy retained per Wet LB 1964 art. 28 lid 1 onder f). Must be true on or before startDate; checked by nl-onboarding-wid-check.

widCheckDate.title: WID check date
widCheckDate.description: Date the WID identity check was performed.

bsnValidated.title: BSN validated
bsnValidated.description: Whether the BSN was checked. Records the outcome only — elfproef modulus-11 automation is a non-goal.

ibanVerified.title: IBAN verified
ibanVerified.description: Whether the IBAN was verified. Records the outcome only — modulus-97 automation is a non-goal.

itProvisioned.title: IT provisioned
itProvisioned.description: Whether the Nextcloud/IT account was provisioned for the hire. Records the outcome only — OCS auto-provisioning is a non-goal.

pensioenAangemeld.title: Pensioen aangemeld
pensioenAangemeld.description: Whether the hire has been registered with the pension fund/administrator.
